subject: Comp concordance for candidate Andy Zhou — payband reconciliation
messages:
From: Ellen Chu <ellen@talentbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Andy Zhou - verbal comp range and materials

Hi Marissa / Lauren,

Quick note — Andy Zhou (finalist for Senior Inference Engineer) has accepted a verbal comp framework from us pending written offer. He signaled openness to join and would like to move quickly. Recruiter readout:
- Preferred start: mid-August
- Expected base: $240,000–$260,000
- Target equity: ~0.45% (4-year, 1y cliff)

I'm attaching his resume and the comp proposal I drafted (comp_proposal_andy_v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether this falls within payband and whether an exception is required? If you can greenlight a specific number I can issue the formal offer & DocuSign.

Attachments: andy_zhou_resume.pdf, comp_proposal_andy_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Ellen Chu
Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge
ellen@talentbridge.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate Andy Zhou - verbal comp range and materials — request: payband confirmation & (if needed) exception path

Team — forwarding Ellen's note. Candidate looks strong from interviews (onsite debrief attached in comp_proposal). We need: 1) payband alignment (what level do we place him — IC3 vs IC4), 2) max base we can approve without exec exception, and 3) equity range confirmation.

My initial read from hiring manager (PM + Eng leads) is IC3 with strong systems/serving experience; manager recommended 245k base + 0.5% equity, but that pushes toward upper band. Can the compensation council confirm whether we can approve 245k base or whether we should escalate?

Please reply inline so I can collate and respond to Ellen by EOD. Attaching comp_approval_sheet_mco_20270614.xlsx with proposed options.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Inference Platform
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Andy Zhou - verbal comp range and materials — request: payband confirmation & (if needed) exception path

Marissa — quick flag from comp ops: official IC3 payband top is $235,000 base; IC4 midpoint is $260,000+. If the manager is recommending 245k, that's above IC3 cap and we'd need a one-off exception approved by the compensation committee (Lauren + Mina sign-off normally).

Options:
- Offer $235k base (IC3 band) + 0.65% equity to chase relative value, or
- Request exception for $245k base (we'd need a short business case and Mina's + Lauren's approval), or
- Re-level to IC4 (requires re-eval of scope/responsibility and manager sign-off)

I attached a short delta calc in the approval sheet. I'm OK moving with exception if leadership agrees — flagging the committee path so we don't miss the DocuSign window.

—Karthik
Compensation Operations
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Andy Zhou - verbal comp range and materials — request: payband confirmation & (if needed) exception path

Folks — thanks for the context and the calc. Reviewed the candidate’s interview summary and manager feedback in the proposal. My read: candidate is strong and the manager's scope justification is reasonable. I will approve a one-off exception up to $245,000 base (one-time exception) provided the following are confirmed:
1) Equity set at 0.5% with standard 4y vesting schedule (documented in offer)
2) Manager commits to accelerated ramp targets (link goals in offer letter)
3) Compensation exception memo (one paragraph) signed off by Mina (for budget owner)

Mina — can you confirm budget availability? If yes, I will sign the comp exception and you and I will sign the approval sheet. Otherwise we default to $235k + equity top-up.

Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Chu <ellen@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Andy Zhou - verbal comp range and materials — final internal alignment

Ellen — internal alignment complete. Summary/decision below (cc'ing internal approvals):

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (final level: IC3 with approved exception)
- Base salary: $245,000 (one-off exception approved by Lauren + Mina)
- Equity: 0.50% (4-year vesting, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $10,000 one-time (manager approved)
- Start target: August 16, 2027

Attachments: comp_approval_sheet_mco_20270614.xlsx (signed by Lauren and Mina)

Please proceed to issue formal offer at $245,000 + 0.5% equity + $10k sign-on. Send DocuSign link when ready and include the exception memo in the packet. Candidate email is andy.zhou@gmail.com.

Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Inference Platform
marissa.cole@redwood.com
